renewal_rent_method:
The Gross Rent during the applicable Extension Term will be one hundred percent (100%) of the then-prevailing market rate for new leases for comparable fully developed and serviced land for industrial use in the area without regard for any inducements such as monetary and non-monetary concessions being granted to tenants for comparable transactions, and excluding brokerage commissions, improvements paid for by tenant improvement allowances, moving allowances, and rent concessions, ("Fair Market Rent"), with 2.5% annual rent increases throughout the Extension Term; provided, however, for the first four (4) Extension Terms (i) if the Fair Market Rent is less than 80% of the Gross Rent for the year immediately preceding expiration of the Term or Extension Term (as the case may be), then the Gross Rent during the applicable Extension Term will be adjusted to 80% of the Gross Rent for the year immediately preceding expiration of the Term or Extension Term (as the case may be), and (ii) if the Fair Market Rent is greater than 102.5% of the Gross Rent for the year immediately preceding expiration of the Term or Extension Term (as the case may be), then the Gross Rent during the applicable Extension Term will be adjusted to 102.5% of the Fair Market Rent; and for the fifth (5th) and sixth (6th) Extension Terms (i) if the Fair Market Rent is less than 80% of the Gross Rent for the year immediately preceding expiration of the fourth (4th) or fifth (5th) Extension Term (as the case may be), then the Gross Rent during the applicable Extension Term will be adjusted to 80% of the Gross Rent for the year immediately preceding expiration of the fourth (4th) or fifth (5th) Extension Term (as the case may be), and (ii) if the Fair Market Rent is greater than 105% of the Gross Rent for the year immediately preceding expiration of the fifth (5th) or sixth (6th) Extension Terms (as the case may be), then the Gross Rent during the applicable Extension Term will be adjusted to 105% of the Fair Market Rent.
(Lease, Addendum 2)

recoveries_audit_dispute_right:
Within one hundred and twenty days (120)following the end of each Accounting Period the LL shall compute the Recoveries for such Accounting Period and shall submit a statement thereof to the T, together with a calculation of the T's share of the Recoveries (the "Statement"),
Neither the LL or the T shall be entitled to dispute the accuracy of any Statement provided by the LL in accordance with the foregoing or claim any reimbursement or adjustment in respect of Recoverable Costs owing in respect of an Accounting Period after the expiry of two (2) years from the date of receipt by the T of the LL's statement for such Accounting Period.

No such review shall be conducted by the T's chartered accountant during the months of October, November or December in any year.
(Lease, 3.3)
opcost_definition:
T shall pay its Proportionate Share of Recoverable Costs.
(Lease, 1.2)

"Recoverable Costs" means, for any Accounting Period, the aggregate of Operating Costs, Utility Costs, Insurance Costs, the Administration Fee and Taxes (less any Taxes apportioned by the LL to the Common Facilities).
(Lease, 1.2)

"Operating Costs" means the total cost (without duplication) to the LL calculated in accordance with sound and generally accepted industry accounting principles, practices and standards for similar buildings in the Greater Toronto Area to be applied by the LL, for the maintenance, repair and operation of the Common Facilities for such Accounting Period.
(Lease, 1.2)

The Basic Rent payable under the Lease is intended to be an absolutely net return to the LL.
(Lease, 3.1)
mgmt_admin_fee_def:

(Lease, 1.2)
capital_amortization:
Y
Operating Costs include Amortization.

(Lease, 1.2)

(Lease, 8.3a)
interest_on_unamortized:

8% per annum in excess of the Bank Rate.

Operating Costs include the reasonable costs of direct supervision and management and indirect expenses, (f) to the extent applicable to the maintenance and operation of the Complex, and all reasonable expenses of every nature incurred in connection with the management, maintenance and operation of the Complex including legal, accounting, architect's, surveyor's and other professional fees such as, without limiting the generality of the foregoing, the costs of computations required for the imposition of charges to tenants, the costs of preparing statements and opinions for tenants and banking fees and expenses and audit fees, but in each case without duplication of the Administration Fee.
(Lease, 1.2)

Operating Costs include the fair rental value (having regard to the rentals prevailing from time to time for similar space) of a reasonable amount of space in the Complex used by the LL in connection with the maintenance, repairs, replacement, operation, administration or management of the Complex and a reasonable allocation of the LL's hardware and software costs related to technology and information systems and a reasonable allocation of all costs relating to the furnishing, equipping, staffing and operation of any regional admin. office serving the Complex, including the fair rental value (having regard to the rentals prevailing from time to time for similar space) of premises used.
(Lease, 1.2)

Operating Costs include all other direct and indirect costs and expenses of every kind, to the extent reasonably incurred in or reasonably allocable to the maintenance, repair, replacement, operation, supervision or administration of all or any part of the Complex, or any of its appurtenances including expenses incurred or contributions made by the LL in respect of off-site facilities which are utilized by or benefit the Complex or for which the LL is required to contribute.

relocation:

$0.20 per sq. ft. of the Rentable Area of the Leased Premises.

(Lease, 9.2d)
relocation:
LL shall have the right to change the location of the Premises to another location elsewhere in the Bldg. with a reasonably similar size. Provided that the LL shall give the T not less than sixty (60) days prior written Notice and the LL shall (a) provide at its expense Leasehold Improvements in the Relocated Premises to a standard similar to the Leasehold Improvements in the Premises as of the date of the Notice of Relocation; and (b) reimburse the T for the actual, reasonable direct moving costs

signage_rights:

If there is an existing podium on the Lands for identification of tenants of the Bldg. (excluding any podium sign for the exclusive use and sole identification of any other tenant of the Bldg.), then, subject to availability, the T may, at the T's expense, install an identification sign on such multi-tenant podium sign of a type, size and in a location specified in writing by the LL.

term_summary:
Initial Term: May 1, 2021 - April 30, 2023 (2 yrs.)
(LEAA, Recitals-A )

Current Term:May 1, 2023 - April 30, 2028 (5 yrs.)
(LEAA, 2)
recoveries_audit_dispute_right:
The T shall not claim a re-adjustment in respect of Operating Costs or Realty Taxes or other items of Additional Rent estimated by the LL or the share payable by the T on account thereof for any Fiscal Period except by written Notice given to the LL within sixty (60) days after delivery of the Statement for the Fiscal Period to which the claim relates.
(Lease, 7.6c)
ll_can_change_proshare:
Y
If it would, in the LL's reasonable opinion, be inequitable or unfair to allocate any of the items in Operating Costs between the T and the other tenants and occupiers of the Bldg. on the basis of the respective areas of their premises, the LL may allocate such cost between the T and such other tenants and occupiers in such manner as the LL, in its reasonable opinion, considers fair and equitable.
(Lease, 3.1)
opcost_definition:
T shall pay its Proportionate Share of Operating Costs.
(Lease, 7.5)

"Operating Costs" means, without duplication, the total amounts incurred, paid or payable by the LL or by others on behalf of the LL in the ownership, operation, maintenance, repair, replacement, improvement, insurance, supervision, management and administration of the Lands and the Bldg.
(Lease, 3.1)

Lease is an absolutely net Lease to the LL.
(Lease, 6.8)
mgmt_admin_fee_def:
T to pay the Management Fee.
(Lease, 6.2a)

"Management Fee" means a management fee for the management of the Bldg. and Lands equal to fifteen percent (15%) of the aggregate of: (a) all costs and expenses included in Operating Costs; and (b) the T's share of Realty Taxes.
(Lease, 3.1)
capital_amortization:
Y
Operating Costs include:
(A) costs of:
(i) operating, maintaining, replacing, modifying and repairing the Common Areas (including the roof structure and/or the roof membrane) and/or the Bldg., including without limitation such costs where incurred by the LL in order to comply with Applicable Laws or required by the LL's insurance carrier or resulting from normal wear and tear to the Bldg.
(ii) providing, installing, operating, inspecting, maintaining, repairing and replacing the Base Bldg. Systems, energy conservation equipment and systems, base bldg. Life Safety Systems and emergency response systems (including emergency lighting systems within Common Areas, base bldg. fire- detection and suppression systems (other than any in-Premises emergency lighting, smoke alarms, co2 detectors, fire extinguishers and fire hoses located within the Premises which are the T's responsibility pursuant to Section 8.1), sprinkler systems and fire, heat, smoke and poisonous gas detectors, monitors and alarms located outside the Premises), and telecommunication and broadband systems and equipment, if any;
(iii) making alterations, replacements or additions to the Bldg. intended to reduce Operating Costs, improve the operation of the Bldg. and the systems, facilities and equipment serving the Bldg., or maintain their operation; and
(iv) replacing machinery or equipment which is used in the regular operation of the Bldg. and Lands, and which by its nature requires periodic replacement whether at the end of such machinery's or equipment's useful life as determined by the LL or otherwise;
(B) depreciation or amortization of the costs referred to above (including, without limitation repair and replacement of facilities, the roof, master utility meters, and all other fixtures, equipment and facilities that are part of the Lands and Bldg., whether incurred before or after the CD), over the useful life of the item as determined in accordance with accounting practices generally accepted in the real estate industry, if such costs have not been charged fully in the Fiscal Year in which they are incurred, and interest on the undepreciated or unamortized balance of such costs, calculated monthly, at an annual rate equal to three percentage points above the Prime Rate.
(C) any costs including capital costs aimed at reducing greenhouse gas emissions or carbon consumed by the Bldg., and of any clean up or removal thereof as required by Applicable Laws of any substance or material existing in, on or upon the Lands, Bldg. that was not previously regulated but subsequently becomes regulated.
(Lease, 3.1)
repairs_maintenance:
Operating Costs include costs of:
(i) operating, maintaining, replacing, modifying and repairing the Common Areas (including the roof structure and/or the roof membrane) and/or the Bldg.;
(ii) providing, installing, operating, inspecting, maintaining, repairing and replacing heating, ventilating and air-conditioning equipment (including such equipment, supplied by the LL, serving leasable premises and the HVAC System), energy conservation equipment and systems, base bldg. Life Safety Systems and emergency response systems, and telecommunication and broadband systems and equipment, if any;
(iii) making alterations, replacements or additions to the Bldg. intended to reduce Operating Costs, improve the operation of the Bldg. and the systems, facilities and equipment serving the Bldg., or maintain their operation; and
(iv) replacing machinery or equipment which is used in the regular operation of the Bldg. and Lands, and which by its nature requires periodic replacement whether at the end of such machinery's or equipment's useful life as determined by the LL or otherwise.
(Lease, 3.1)

LL will operate, maintain and repair the Common Areas, as well as the Base Bldg. Systems (including the fire pump) in accordance with Section 8.3, as would a prudent owner of a similar industrial bldg., having regard to size, age and location and all expenses incurred by the LL shall be included in Operating Costs.
(Lease, 9.1)

“Base Bldg. Systems” means components of the HVAC System and the associated control systems located outside of the Bldg. but excluding any supplemental systems or trade fixtures installed by or on behalf of the T which exclusively serve the Premises; the Life Safety System required to meet applicable bldg. and fire codes based on the layout and floor plan of the Bldg. existing as of the Possession Date (but, for clarity, excluding extinguishers, hoses, emergency lighting and any specialized systems specific to the Permitted Use); plumbing to the point where it enters and exits the Bldg.; and electrical connections to the point entering the Bldg. and located within the Common Areas.
(Lease, 3.1)
interest_on_unamortized:
Y
Three percentage points above the Prime Rate.
(Lease, 3.1)
ga_operational_wages:
Y
Operating Costs include supervision, management and administration of the Lands and the Bldg.

Operating Costs include amounts paid to, or reasonably attributable to the remuneration of, all personnel (whether on or off-site and whether employed by the LL or a management company) involved in the maintenance, repair, replacement, operation, administration, supervision and management of the Bldg., including Workers Compensation insurance, pension plan contributions, fringe benefits, severance pay, termination payments and other employment costs.

Operating Costs include auditing, accounting, legal and other professional and consulting fees and disbursements incurred in connection with the maintenance, repair, replacement, operation, administration, supervision and management of the Bldg., including those incurred with respect to the preparation of the statements required under the provisions of the Lease.

Operating Costs include management office rent imputed to the Bldg. by the LL (as well as an allocation of the costs and expenses for the maintenance, repair and administration of such management office).
(Lease, 3.1)
direct_use:
Operating Costs include (i) cost of cleaning, snow removal, garbage and waste collection (excluding Leasable premises), recycling and disposal, landscaping, paving, line painting, and maintenance of roadways, curbs and sidewalks; and (ii) cost of public utilities serving the Common Areas and electricity for signs that are a part of the Common Areas and the LL's costs of determining and/or investigating utility charges including professional, engineering and consulting fees and procuring any utility supply contracts.
(Lease, 3.1)

T shall pay as the same becomes due respectively, all taxes and charges for public and private utilities, including water, gas, electrical power or energy, steam or hot water used upon or in respect of the Premises.
(i) If the Premises are separately metered, at the LL's option either: (1) the T shall enter into such contracts or other arrangements in connection with the utilities which the LL requests it to and will pay whatever deposits or other amounts which are payable under those contracts or other arrangements; or (2) the LL shall maintain its direct account with the utility supplier and pay whatever deposits and amounts payable to such utility supplier for consumption of such utility at the Premises, and T shall reimburse the LL all such costs (other than costs of any required deposit) and the LL's fifteen percent (15%) administration fee thereon as Additional Rent. No administration fee is payable for amounts billed directly to the T by a supplier of utilities and paid by the T directly to the supplier.
(ii) If the Premises are not separately metered, the LL shall allocate to the Premises and the T shall pay an equitable amount as reasonably determined by the LL having regard among other things without limitation to the T's connected load and the then current applicable commercial rates for the municipality in which the Premises is located, together with the LL's costs of determining the amount including, but not limited to, professional, engineering and consulting fees, and the LL's fifteen percent (15%) administration fee on the total referred to above.
(Lease, 7.7)
renewal_rights: N/A
renewal_rent_method: N/A

If at any time LL decides to reconstruct, renovate, alter, redevelop, demolish or change the use of all or any part of the Bldg., the LL may terminate the Lease by giving not less than sixty (60) days' Notice in writing to the T.
(Lease, 9.2d)
relocation:
LL shall have the right, at any time and from time to time during the Term of the Lease and any renewal or extension thereof, to change the location of the Premises from the location described in the Lease to another location elsewhere in the Bldg. with a reasonably similar size. Provided that the LL shall give the T not less than sixty (60) days prior written Notice of such relocation and the LL shall (a) provide at its expense Leasehold Improvements in the Relocated Premises to a standard similar to the Leasehold Improvements in the Premises as of the date of the Notice of Relocation; and (b) reimburse the T for the actual, reasonable direct moving costs.
(Lease, 9.5)
ti_allowances:
Up to $4.00 per sq. ft. of the Rentable Area of the New Premises.

signage_rights:
T may, at its expense, erect and maintain one (1) identification signage on the window glazing of the Premises of a type, size and in a location specified in writing by the LL.
(Lease, 8.8)

term_summary:
Initial Term: April 1, 2009 - March 31, 2014 (5 yrs.)
Extension Term: April 1, 2014 - March 31, 2019 (5 yrs.)
Current Extension Term: April 1, 2019 - September 30, 2025 (6.5 yrs.)
Exercised Extension Term: October 1, 2025 - Expiry Date* (Approx. 3 yrs.)
(LEAA 2023, Recitals)

*Expiry Date: 5 years after: (i) the Expansion Term Effective Date if the Effective Date is the first day of a calendar month, or (ii) the last day of the month in which the Expansion Term commenced if the Effective Date is other than the first day of a calendar month.
(LEAA 2023, 2, 3)
rentable_sqft:
A total of 8,184 sq. ft., including: (a) Units no. 9 and 10, comprising a Rentable Area of approx. 5,541 sq. ft. (the “Relocated Premises”) and (b) Unit No. 8 of the Bldg., comprising a Rentable Area of approx. 2,643 sq. ft. (the “Expansion Premises”).
(LEAA 2023, 2) (LEAA 2023, Recitals)

At LL's option, the Rentable Area of the Relocated Premises is subject to re-measurement based upon measurement by LL's architect or other qualified professionals in accordance with BOMA 2017 measurement standards.
(LEAA 2018, 4)

"Rentable Area" of the Premises shall be calculated in accordance with the current Society of Industrial and Office Realtor's method for measuring industrial space, Method "B". Every other Rentable Area shall be as determined by the Architect from time to time.
(Lease, 2.38)
recoveries_audit_dispute_right:
As soon as practicable, not to exceed 180 days (it being acknowledged that neither party shall be relieved of its obligations as a result of LL's failure to deliver such statement within such 180-day period) after the expiration of each fiscal period, LL shall make a final determination of the amounts payable by T pursuant hereto for such fiscal period and shall furnish to T, showing in reasonable detail the method by which the same has been calculated, a statement of the actual Operating Costs, Management Fee and Realty Taxes for such fiscal period.
(Lease, 5.4)
opcost_proshare_definition:
Proshare:
PRS means a fraction which has as its numerator the Rentable Area of the Premises and which has as its denominator the aggregate Rentable Area of Leasable Areas within the Project or Bldg. or such portion or portions thereof to which LL, acting reasonably and equitably, shall allocate such items of which T is required to pay the Proportionate Share, all as determined by LL, acting reasonably and equitably, subject to adjustment pursuant to Section 7.2(b). For the purpose of determining the denominator as aforesaid, the Rentable Area of all Leasable Areas within the Project or Bldg. shall be determined in the same manner as the Rentable Area of the Premises as set forth in Section 2.38.
(Lease, 2.35)
ll_can_change_proshare:
Operating Costs include all costs incurred by LL for the purpose or intent of investigating or reducing any Operating Costs, Realty Taxes or other taxes, whether or not Operating Costs, Realty Taxes or other taxes are in fact reduced, and costs incurred for the purpose of allocating Realty Taxes and/or utilities among T and other occupants of the Project.
(Lease, 2.28a(xviii))

LL, acting reasonably, shall have the right to allocate Operating Costs or any portion or portions thereof to such portion or portions of the Bldg. or the Project as LL shall determine.
(Lease, 2.28d)

If T or any other tenant of the Project, pursuant to its lease or otherwise by arrangement with LL, provides at its cost any goods or services the cost of which would otherwise be included in Operating Costs, or if any goods or services the cost of which is included in Operating Costs benefit any portion of the Project to a materially greater or lesser extent than any other portion of the Project, then either the denominator for determining a Proportionate Share, or alternatively the amount of Operating Costs, may be adjusted as determined by LL, at its option, to provide for the equitable allocation of the cost of such goods and services among the tenants of the Project.
(Lease, 7.2b)
opcost_definition:
T shall pay to LL PRS of Operating Costs.
(Lease, 7.1)

"Operating Costs" means the aggregate of all expenses and costs of every kind determined, for each fiscal period designated by LL, on an accrual basis and without duplication, incurred by or on behalf of LL with respect to and for the operation, maintenance, repair, replacement and management of the Project and all insurance relating to the Project.
(Lease, 2.28a)

It is the intent of the parties that the Lease be a lease that is absolutely net to LL.
(Lease, 3.1)
mgmt_admin_fee_def:
T shall pay the Management Fee.
(Lease, 5.2b(iii))

"Management Fee" shall mean an amount equal to up to 5% of T's Proportionate Share of all gross amounts received or receivable by LL in respect of the Project for all items, including all such items as are included in the Lease as Rent (except, to avoid duplication, for the amount payable under subsection 5.2(b)), assuming full occupancy and disregarding any reduction, limitation, deferral or abatement of any amounts in the nature of Rent but excluding any amounts recovered by LL from T as Excess Costs and which would be recoverable from other tenants for amounts which would be Excess Costs if their leases contained provisions similar to those contained).
(Lease, 2.27)
capital_amortization:
Operating Costs include amortization of the costs of all items which LL, in its sole discretion, chooses not to charge in the year incurred, over such period as determined by LL in its sole discretion, on a straight line basis to zero and interest to be calculated and paid annually on the unamortized cost of such items in respect of which amortization is included at 2% per annum in excess of the Prime Rate.
(Lease, 2.28a(vi))
repairs_maintenance:
Operating Costs shall include: (ii) HVAC and fire sprinkler maintenance and monitoring, if any, of the Project; (v) landscaping and maintenance of all outside areas, including snow and ice removal; and (ix) all maintenance, repairs and replacements in respect of the Project and all machinery, furniture, furnishings, equipment, facilities, systems, property and fixtures located therein.
(Lease, 2.28a)

T, at its sole expense, shall perform or cause to be performed as required such maintenance, repairs and replacements and upgrading to keep the Premises and all the contents thereof to Bldg. Standard,
For the purposes of this Section 10.1 only, Premises shall not include utility rooms and base Bldg. mechanical and electrical systems, whether or not located within the Premises.
(Lease, 10.1)

LL shall repair and/or replace, as the case may be: (a) the structure and exterior walls of the Bldg.; (b) the transportation, electrical, mechanical and drainage equipment and base Bldg. systems forming part of the Project (including base Bldg. systems located within the Premises and Common Facilities of the Project); and (c) Common Facilities to the extent required to maintain Bldg. Standard. LL's costs of compliance with Section 10.6 shall be included in Operating Costs to the extent provided in the definition thereof.
(Lease, 10.6)

Operating Costs shall include all costs in respect of the maintenance, repair and replacement of the Common Facilities including, HVAC system, structure of the Bldg. including the roof and all shipping and Bldg. doors (including levelers, canopies, seals and bumpers) and life safety systems.
(LEAA 2018, 8)

"Common Facilities" means: (i) the Project (excluding only Leasable Areas), including, without limitation: all areas, facilities, structures, systems, improvements, furniture, fixtures and equipment forming part of or located on the Project; the lands forming part of the Project; the Parking Facilities and other service areas and facilities, if any; LL's management offices and facilities to the extent used for the management of the Project; Storage Areas; and (2) all lands, areas, facilities, systems, improvements, structures, furniture, fixtures and equipment serving or benefiting the Project.
(Lease, 2.10)
interest_on_unamortized:
2% per annum in excess of the Prime Rate.
(Lease, 2.28a(vi))
ga_operational_wages:
Operating Costs include management.
(Lease, 2.28a)

Operating Costs shall include (i) all remuneration including wages and benefits of employees to the extent employed or engaged in the operation, maintenance, repair, replacement, and management of the Project including contributions and premiums towards unemployment and Workers Compensation insurance, pension plan contributions and similar premiums and contributions; (x) engineering, accounting, legal and other consulting and professional services related to the Project, including the cost of preparing and verifying statements respecting Operating Costs and Realty Taxes; and (xvii) the fair rental value (having regard to rentals prevailing from time to time for similar space) of amenities for the Project and of space occupied by LL or others for management, supervisory, admin. or operational purposes relating to the Project and all office expenses incurred therein.
(Lease, 2.28a)
direct_use:
Operating Costs include (iii) cleaning, janitorial services, window cleaning, waste removal and pest control; and (iv) the provision of all utilities supplied to the Project and the cost of consumption of all utilities consumed on the Project including, without limitation, hot and cold water, gas, electricity, steam, sewer charges and any other utilities or forms of energy.
(Lease, 2.28a(iii), (iv))

LL will provide all utility services for the normal use of the Premises. All expenses relating to such usual use will form part of Operating Costs.
As at the date of the Lease, gas and hydro supplied to the Premises are measured by separate meters and T shall pay to LL or to the supplier of such utilities, as LL directs, the cost of such gas and hydro consumption in the Premises, as Additional Rent, on the basis of such actual consumption.
To the extent any utility is not measured by way of separate meters LL, acting reasonably, shall allocate the cost of same among the various users thereof and such allocation by LL shall be final and binding upon T. If LL, acting reasonably, determines T to be an excess consumer of any such utility (not separately metered) in the Premises, at LL's option, T shall install at its expense a separate meter or check meter to measure the consumption of same, the type of meter and location to be as determined by LL. Whether or not there are separate meters or checks meters measuring the utilities consumed in the Premises, LL, acting reasonably, may charge (and T shall pay for) such utilities based on LL's estimate or T's Proportionate Share.
LL will be responsible for quarterly inspection and general maintenance of, and for all repairs and replacements to, the HVAC Units, the costs for which shall be included in Operating Costs.
(Lease, 9.1)

If, by reason of: (i) the particular use or occupancy of the Premises or any of the Common Facilities; or (ii) the requirement for any services beyond bldg. standard services, such as, without limitation, waste removal; additional costs in the nature of Operating Costs such as, without limitation, costs of: insurance (including insurance increases incurred by tenants of the Project); security; and/or waste disposal, are incurred in excess of the costs which would otherwise have been incurred for such items, then LL shall have the right, but not the obligation, to determine such excess costs on a reasonable basis ("Excess Costs") and require T to pay such Excess Costs, plus 15% of the amount thereof.
(Lease, 7.2a)

T shall not allow any refuse, garbage or any loose, objectionable material to accumulate in or about the Premises or the Project. T at its expense shall at all times comply with LL's rules and regulations regarding the separation, removal, storage and disposal of waste for the Premises. LL shall have the option to take over the function of separating, removing and/or disposing of the waste and the cost to LL of same shall be included in Operating Costs. T shall be responsible for all costs of removal of waste from the Premises other than costs of routine waste removal included in Operating Costs.
(Lease, 8.6)
property_tax_allocation:
T shall pay to LL or the relevant taxing authority, as required by LL, all Realty Taxes levied, confirmed, imposed, assessed or charged ( collectively or individually referred to as "charged") against or in respect of the Premises.
(Lease, 6.2)

Whether or not there is a separate bill for Realty Taxes charged against the Premises or a separate assessment, the Realty Taxes charged against the Premises shall be determined by LL and the cost of making such determination shall be included in Operating Costs. In making such determination LL shall have the right, but not the obligation, to allocate Realty Taxes to the Premises and all other portions of the Project by using such criteria as LL, in its sole discretion, shall determine to be relevant, including:
(a) the then current established principles of assessment used by the relevant assessing authorities;
(b) assessments of the Premises and any other portions of the Project in previous periods of time;
(c) the Proportionate Share;
(d) any act, religion or election of T or any other occupant of the Project which results in an increase or decrease in the amount of Realty Taxes which would otherwise have been charged against the Project or any portion thereof;
(e) the quality of construction, use, location within the Project or income generated by the Premises and/or the assessor's valuation of the Premises or Project; and
(f) tax classifications of tenants in the Project, as determined by LL.

Notwithstanding any other contrary provisions of the Lease, if, at any time during a fiscal period, any part of the Project is not 100% occupied, the Realty Taxes shall be allocated by LL to the Bldg.(s), the Common Facilities and the other components of the Project without regard to any credits which may be received or receivable by LL in respect of any vacant premises within the Project and without regard to any reduced tax rate for such vacant premises. LL may use an expert to assist it in making such determination and allocation and all cost incurred in so doing shall be included in Operating Costs.
(Lease, 6.3)

Operating Costs include business taxes, if any, on Common Facilities, Realty Taxes charged against or in respect of or reasonably allocated by LL to Common Facilities and the amount, if any, of Realty Taxes charged against the Project in excess of the amount of Realty Taxes in the aggregate, charged against or allocated by LL to Leasable Areas.
(Lease, 2.28a(xii))

"Project" means the Lands, the Bldg. and all other buildings, structures, improvements, equipment and facilities of any kind erected or located thereon from time to time.
(Lease, 2.34)

"Common Facilities" means: (1) the Project (excluding only Leasable Areas), including, without limitation: all areas, facilities, structures, systems, improvements, furniture, fixtures and equipment forming part of or located on the Project; the lands forming part of the Project; the Parking Facilities and other service areas and facilities, if any; LL's management offices and facilities to the extent used for the management of the Project; Storage Areas; and (2) all lands, areas, facilities, systems, improvements, structures, furniture, fixtures and equipment serving or benefiting the Project.
(Lease, 2.10)
renewal_rights: N/A
renewal_rent_method: N/A
relocation:
LL shall have the right to make any changes in, additions to, deletions from, rearrangements of or relocations of any part or parts of the Project, including the Premises, as LL shall consider necessary or desirable, provided that as a result of effecting such Changes, the Premises shall be substantially the same in size as the Premises described and T shall at no time be prevented from conducting business in the Premises as altered or relocated by such Changes.
If the Premises or any portion thereof are relocated as a result of such Changes after commencement of the Term, LL shall be responsible for the direct cost of moving T to the relocated Premises and constructing replacement Leasehold Improvements therein (but not for any indirect costs or losses such as overhead costs, loss of revenue or profit).
(Lease, 17.2)
signage_rights:

Whether or not there is a separate bill for Realty Taxes charged against the Premises or a separate assessment, the Realty Taxes charged against the Premises shall be determined by LL and the cost of making such determination shall be included in Operating Costs. In making such determination LL shall have the right, but not the obligation, to allocate Realty Taxes to the Premises and all other portions of the Project by using such criteria as LL, in its sole discretion, shall determine to be relevant including, without limitation:
(a) the then current established principles of assessment used by the relevant assessing authorities;
(b) assessments of the Premises and any other portions of the Project in previous periods of time;
(c) the Proportionate Share;
(d) any act, religion or election of T or any other occupant of the Project which results in an increase or decrease in the amount of Realty Taxes which would otherwise have been charged against the Project or any portion thereof;
(e) the quality of construction, use, location within the Project or income generated by the Premises and/or the assessor's valuation of the Premises or Project; and
(f) tax classifications of tenants in the Project, as determined by LL.

Notwithstanding any other contrary provisions of the Lease, if, at any time during a fiscal period, any part of the Project is not 100% occupied, the Realty Taxes shall be allocated by LL to the Bldg.(s), the Common Facilities and the other components of the Project without regard to any credits which may be received or receivable by LL in respect of any vacant premises within the Project and without regard to any reduced tax rate for such vacant premises. recoveries_audit_dispute_right:
As soon as practicable, not to exceed one hundred and eighty (180) days after the expiration of each fiscal period, LL shall make a final determination of the amounts payable by T and shall furnish to T a statement of the actual Operating Costs and Realty Taxes for such fiscal period.
T agrees that it shall not be entitled to make any claim, including the commencing of an action against LL, with respect to any Additional Rent charges payable for any fiscal period unless such claim is made within six (6) months after the date on which LL has delivered to T a Final Statement for such fiscal period.
(Lease , 5.4)
ll_can_change_proshare:
LL, acting reasonably, shall have the right to allocate Operating Costs or any portion or portions thereof to such portion or portions of the Bldg. or the Project as LL shall determine.
(Lease , 2.28d)
opcost_definition:
T shall pay to LL the Operating Costs.
(Lease , 7.1)

"Operating Costs" means the aggregate of all expenses and costs of every kind determined, for each fiscal period designated by LL, on an accrual basis and without duplication, incurred by or on behalf of LL with respect to and for the operation, maintenance, repair, replacement and management of the Project and all insurance relating to the Premises.
(Lease , 2.28)

It is the intent of the parties that the Lease be a lease that is absolutely net to LL.
(Lease , 3.1)
mgmt_admin_fee_def:
T shall pay the Management Fee.
(Lease , 5.2b)

"Management Fee" shall mean an amount equal to up to  five percent (5%) of T's Proportionate Share of all gross amounts received or receivable by LL in respect of the Project for all items, including all such items as are included in the Lease as Rent (except, to avoid duplication, for the amount payable under subsection 5.2(b)), assuming full occupancy and disregarding any reduction, limitation, deferral or abatement of any amounts in the nature of Rent but excluding any amounts recovered by LL from T as Excess Costs and which would be recoverable from other tenants for amounts which would be Excess Costs if their leases contained provisions similar to those contained).
(Lease , 2.27)
capital_amortization:
Operating Costs include amortization of the costs of all items which LL, in its sole discretion, chooses not to charge in the year incurred, over such period as determined by LL in its sole discretion, on a straight line basis to zero and interest to be calculated and paid annually on the unamortized cost of such items in respect of which amortization is included at two percent (2%) per annum in excess of the Prime Rate.
(Lease , 2.28a(vi))
repairs_maintenance:
Operating Costs include HVAC and fire sprinkler maintenance and monitoring, if any, of the Project;
(Lease , 2.28a(ii))

LL shall repair and/or replace:
(a) the structure and exterior walls of the Bldg.;
(b) the transportation, electrical, mechanical and drainage equipment and base Bldg. systems forming part of the Project (including base Bldg. systems located within the Premises and Common Facilities of the Project); and 
(c) Common Facilities.
LL's costs of the above shall be included in Operating Costs to the extent provided in the definition thereof.
(Lease , 10.6)
interest_on_unamortized:
2% per annum in excess of the Prime Rate.
(Lease , 2.28(vi))
ga_operational_wages:
Operating Costs include management.

Operating Costs shall include (i) all remuneration including wages and benefits of employees to the extent employed or engaged in the operation, maintenance, repair, replacement, and management of the Project including contributions and premiums towards unemployment and Workers Compensation insurance, pension plan contributions and similar premiums and contributions; and (ii) the fair rental value (having regard to rentals prevailing from time to time for similar space) of amenities for the Project and of space occupied by LL or others for management, supervisory, admin. or operational purposes relating to the Project and all office expenses incurred therein.
(Lease , 2.28a)
direct_use:
LL will provide all utility services for the normal use of the Premises. All expenses relating to such usual use will form part of Operating Costs.
As at the Lease date, gas and hydro supplied to the Premises are measured by separate meters and T shall pay to LL or to the supplier of such utilities, as LL directs, the cost of such gas and hydro consumption in the Premises, as Additional Rent, on the basis of such actual consumption.

T shall comply with all rules and regulations as LL shall make from time to time respecting the maintenance, repair and operation of all such HVAC Units.
LL will be responsible for quarterly inspection and general maintenance of, and for all repairs and replacements to, the HVAC Units, the costs for which shall be included in Operating Costs. 
(Lease , 9.1)
property_tax_allocation:
T shall pay to LL or the relevant taxing authority, as required by LL, all Realty Taxes.
(Lease , 6.2)

signage_rights:

(Lease , 8.4)

recoveries_audit_dispute_right:
The LL shall deliver to the T within one hundred and eighty (180) days after the end of each Fiscal Period a written statement or statements (the “Statement”) setting out with reasonable detail the amount of Operating Costs, the Realty Taxes and such other items of Additional Rent as the LL actually incurred for such Fiscal Period (including the Management Fee).
The T shall not claim a re-adjustment in respect of Operating Costs or Realty Taxes or other items of Additional Rent estimated by the LL for any Fiscal Period except by written Notice given to the LL within one hundred and twenty (120) days after delivery of the Statement for the Fiscal Period to which the claim relates.
The Statement in respect of any Fiscal Period shall be final and binding upon the parties and the T may not claim any re-adjustment in respect of the T’s Proportionate Share of Operating Costs and the T’s share of Taxes or the Management Fee for a Fiscal Period for any reason, except by written notice (the “Review Notice”) delivered to the LL within one hundred and twenty (120) days of the date of delivery of such Statement (the “Review Period”).
In the Review Notice, the T shall set out the question(s) which it wishes to address (it being understood that this right shall not be exercised so as to be tantamount to an audit but, rather will be limited to specific reasonable questions).
(Lease, 7.6)

opcost_definition:

It is intended that the Lease is a completely care-free net lease to the LL, and that the LL is not responsible during the Term of the Lease for any costs, charges, expenses and outlays of any nature whatsoever arising from or relating to the Leased Premises or the use and occupancy thereof or to the contents thereof, or the business carried on therein, and the T shall pay all charges, impositions, costs and expenses of any nature or kind relating to the Leased Premises.

opcost_exclusions_yn:

Operating Costs shall exclude the following: (I) repairs to or replacements of the Structure unless same is damaged due to the negligence of the T or those for whom the T is in law responsible in which case the cost of restoring damage to the Structure shall be paid for by the T; and for clarity the foregoing will not prohibit the LL from including in Operating Costs the day-to-day maintenance of the Structure; (II) net proceeds from insurance policies taken out by the LL, to the extent such proceeds relate to costs and expenses incurred in the maintenance and operation of the Leased Premises; (III) repairs or replacements to the extent that the cost of same is recovered by the LL under warranties or from third-parties or for which a third-party other than the T is obligated to reimburse the LL; (IV) any income taxes and other such taxes personal to the LL (excluding Capital Taxes which are included in Operating Costs); (V) all costs which relate to any bldg. in or improvement to the Lands, other than the Bldg. or any other bldg. leased and/or occupied by the T, and other than costs which the LL allocates to common areas, common elements or common use equipment (it being understood and agreed that in the case of a third party tenant occupying the Expansion Lands, the T shall pay to the LL the T's proportionate share of costs applicable to common areas, common elements or common use equipment on the Lands); (VI) any amounts directly charged by and reimbursed (or obligated to be reimbursed) to the LL for any service, goods and benefits provided by the LL to any particular tenant or occupant of the Land, other than the T on an individual basis; (VII) employment costs of the LL's employees who perform leasing or other admin. functions not related to the management, administration and/or operation of the Leased Premises (VIII) marketing costs and leasing fees, costs associated with renovating or improving tenant spaces (other than the T), costs or expenses for which the LL is entitled to be reimbursed from another party including insurers, contractors, suppliers or other tenants of the LL ; (IX) costs or expenses for which the primary purpose is to expand or enlarge the Bldg. other than an expansion or enlargement made at the request of T or pursuant to the Lease; (X) all fines, suits, claims, demands, costs, charges and expenses for which the LL is liable by reason of the negligent or willful misconduct of the LL and for those persons whom it is in law responsible; (XI) payments of principal, finance charges or interest on debt or amortization on any mortgages, deeds of trust or any other debt for borrowed money, or rental payments (or increases of same) under any ground or underlying lease or leases (except to the extent that the same may be made to pay or to reimburse for Realty Taxes or insurance premiums); (XII) costs of defending suits with any mortgagee (except where the actions of the T may be an issue), costs of selling (including transfer taxes), syndicating, financing, mortgaging or hypothecating any interest of the LL in, or in sale/leaseback transaction relating to, the Bldg. or the Lands, and costs (including attorneys' fees, costs of settlement and judgments) arising from disputes or claims pertaining to the LL (except where the actions of the T are the cause of the dispute or claim); (XIII) interest, fines or penalties due to the LL's failure to pay timely any Realty Taxes, utilities or other charges, or due to the LL's failure to comply with any law to the extent such failure is not caused by the T's failure to make timely payment or to perform the T's obligations; (XIV) any cost or expense related to removal, cleaning, abatement or remediation of Hazardous Substances in or about the Bldg. and/or the Lands, including, without limitation, Hazardous Substances in the ground water or soil, but excluding, however, cost or expenses associated with any removal, clean-up or remediation for which T is specifically liable for under the Lease; (XV) advertising and promotional expenses incurred to publicize or lease (or keep leased) the Bldg., or any portion thereof, unless the need to do so follows termination of the Lease due to T's defaulting; (XVI) contributions to political and charitable organizations; and (XVII) contributions to operating expense reserves.

For each calendar year from and after the Base Year, the Landscaping Operating Costs to be included in Operating Costs solely for purposes of calculating the Administration Fee shall be deemed to be an amount equal to the Landscaping Operating Costs paid by the T in the immediately preceding calendar year multiplied by 1.05.

property_tax_allocation:
The T will pay to the LL all Realty Taxes assessed against or attributable to the Leased Lands (or if not separately assessed or identified then as may be reasonably attributed or allocated by the LL to the Leased Lands as set out in subsections (i) and (ii) below);
(i) if there are separate assessments for the Leased Lands, then the T’s Realty Taxes with respect to the Leased Lands will be as set out in the separate assessments; or
(ii) if there are no separate assessments for the Leased Lands, then the T will pay a share of Realty Taxes which has been apportioned to the Leased Lands by the LL on a reasonable and equitable basis using the same methodology and principles as the assessment authority for the Leased Lands would use including the assessment authority's working papers (if any), provided that, so long as the T is 2778090 Ontario Inc. or a member of the Loblaw Group, if there are no separate assessments for the Leased Lands and working papers are not available to determine separate assessments for the Leased Lands, then the LL and the T, each acting reasonably and equitably, may mutually determine a fair and equitable allocation of Realty Taxes for the Leased Lands, using the same methodology and principles as the assessor would use and may utilize a qualified independent tax consultant mutually acceptable to the LL and the T, each acting reasonably, to assist in such determination, and the cost of such tax consultant shall be shared equally between the parties. In the event that LL and T are unable to agree upon a fair and equitable allocation of Realty Taxes for the Leased Lands, then such fair and equitable allocation will be determined by arbitration pursuant to Section 16.1.
(Lease, 5.2)

Shared Facilities Costs include any Realty Taxes which are levied, imposed, assessed or charged by any lawful taxing authority against the Shared Facilities or any Realty Taxes which are attributed or allocated to Shared Facilities by the LL on a reasonable and equitable basis (and without duplication). For greater certainty, in the event the Leased Lands are valued by the assessor using the income approach to value, or in the event separate assessments for the Leased Lands exist, then it is acknowledged by the LL and the T that the T's share of Realty Taxes in respect of any portion of the Shared Facilities which are situated within and form part of the Leased Lands is included in these separate assessments and no additional amounts shall be payable by the T for Realty Taxes in respect of any Shared Facilities which are situated within and form part of the Leased Lands unless a separate assessment is issued for such portion of the Shared Facilities which are situated within and form part of the Leased Lands and a proportionate amount (as determined by the LL and the T, each acting reasonably) is deducted from the separate assessments for the Leased Lands.
(Lease, 1.2)

If the LL elects to sell, assign, transfer or convey in any way its ownership interest in:
Encumbered Area: all or part of the Leased Lands and/or all of part of the Lands (which are comprised of the Leased Lands and the portion of the Lands identified as ‘Site A Area’ and ‘Proposed Bldg. A’ on the Site Plan) (the “ROFO Lands”)

other_revenue_sources:

T elected to reimburse the LL for the LL’s Additional Work Costs, by way of increasing the Basic Rent payable during the Initial Term by the total amount of the LL’s Additional Work Cost amortized over the Initial Term at an interest rate of six percent (6%) per annum over the Initial Term (with such amount divided into equal annual instalments). Accordingly, the LL and the T agree that Eight Million Dollars ($8,000,000.00) of the Total Estimated Cost (the “Additional Work Amortized Amount”) shall be reimbursed by the T through Basic Rent ($625,894.00/annum) and the remainder of the Total Estimated Cost shall be paid by the T within thirty (30) days of receipt of an invoice from the LL following completion of the LL’s Additional Work.

In the event that such consent is required and the LL is unable to obtain such consent, the T may bring such application and in the event that the T chooses not to make such application or is unable to obtain such consent, the maximum term of the Lease, including renewals, shall be limited to twenty one (21) years less a day.
(Lease, 18.6)
